phrase: An executive's secret relationship becomes a company scandal, under investigation from his own board. Elsewhere, headset makers are quietly reading users' brainwaves to train AI.
phraseAlternatives: A company is investigating its own boss over a secret relationship he admitted in a memo. Meanwhile, some headsets already read brain signals to train AI.
An executive's affair became a boardroom investigation this week. Quietly, wearable headsets are already reading real brain signals and feeding them into AI training.
One company's leader admitted a secret relationship as the board opened an inquiry. Elsewhere, headset makers read users' brainwaves to train AI, unannounced.
A CEO's private life became company business after a board inquiry began. Some wearables, it turns out, already read your brain to train AI.
alt: A building drawn in cross-section shows a worker inside being examined by a large magnifying glass, under a tag reading internal review. Beside it, a calm person wearing a wired headband sends wavy signal lines, one marked with a yellow highlight, up into a small cloud icon tagged brain data.

brief.concept: A company investigates its own executive over a secret relationship he admitted to in a memo, and in the same week, wearable headset makers are quietly reading ordinary people's brain signals to train AI.
brief.metaphor: Two kinds of mind-reading at once: a company reading its boss's secrets, and a device reading its owner's mind.

cast.who: a company building shining a large magnifying glass inward on itself
a human figure at a desk inside, holding a torn note with a heart crossed out
a human wearing a wired headband, eyes closed, sitting calmly
a cloud-shaped AI drawing wavy signal lines straight from the headband

brief.composition: Split frame. Left half: a company building rendered in cross-section, its own magnifying glass turned inward on a human figure at a desk holding a torn, heart-crossed note. Right half: a calm human wearing a wired headband, wavy signal lines flowing from the headband into a cloud-shaped AI icon. One yellow highlight marks the signal lines reaching the cloud.
brief.alt: A building examines one of its own workers with a giant magnifying glass, while beside it, a calm person wearing a wired headband sends wavy brain-signal lines into a cloud-shaped AI icon.
